# Auth method commands expose list/add/remove and preserve connect-only
# behavior when listing methods without a daemon.
spacewave auth method --help
stdout "manage auth methods (entity keypairs)"
stdout "list registered entity keypairs"
stdout "add an authentication method"
stdout "remove an auth method by peer ID"

spacewave auth method add --help
stdout "add a new password-derived keypair"
stdout "add a PEM backup key as an auth method"
stdout "generate a backup key, register it, and save the PEM file"

! spacewave auth method list --state-path $WORK/state
stderr "no daemon listening"
